These 3 files alone at load about 21 on 4 CPUs: 4 timeouts; with --testTimeout=120000: 33 passed. It timed out the same way on the base source (scratch git checkout 0436a53 of AtlasSheet.astro and atlasData.ts, 5896 ms, same load). It passes alone ('3 passed') on both and with --testTimeout=120000. The fix changes only string literals in atlasData.ts.

Wording (minor, not a regression of either finding). The new sentence writes 'a mutation at node i replaces p_i by p_i - a_i'. SPEC 2.4(a) line 201 writes 'a mutation at i replaces p_i by p_i - a_i' with no noun, and line 199 'mutating city i'. M0 (m0-start.mdx:83) and M4 (m4-numbers.mdx:73) copy SPEC's 'a mutation at $i$'. Elsewhere the site mostly puts a mutation on a city: glossary 'To mutate city $i$', confusions.mdx:25 'a mutation at city $i$', not-quiver-mutation 'a mutation at city 2'. The bridge sentence that follows calls the same place 'city i'. P8 is kept by its letter (no sentence names both), and confusions.mdx:39 and :51 already write 'a mutation at node $i$', so the terms are the site's own. Writing 'a mutation at i' (SPEC's words) would align it with 2.4(a), M0 and M4. No em-dash in any added prose or in the decisions fragment.

Recorded choice the owner may want to see. The item heading changed from 'Orbits of the fundamental weights' to 'Orbits of the fundamental positions' (h2 and contents link; anchor #orbit-sizes and data-out fundamental-orbit-sizes unchanged). The finding's proposedFix kept the heading, which follows the wording of SPEC 4 T14 'orbit sizes of the fundamental weights'. The change is logged in decisions/RT-FIX-P6-atlas.md as replacing the title in decisions/P6-A4.md, so it is not unrecorded. Only the 5 listed files changed. No golden value, convention, engine file or registry is touched, and no .only or .skip was added.
